_readme: Fingerprint of the schema that supabase/schema.sql + supabase/migrations/**
produce when replayed in the order declared by tests/schema-apply-order.json.
Regenerate ONLY with `node tests/schema-drift.mjs --write`, and only when the
schema change was intended — the diff of this file is the review surface.
What it can and cannot see is documented in the header of tests/schema-drift.mjs.

known_production_delta.method: Object inventory pulled from the live catalog and set-differenced against the PGlite replay of this repo, category by category (relations, functions, policies, indexes, triggers, constraints, columns, event triggers). Read-only queries only.
known_production_delta.production_only: NONE, as of this measurement. Before the three 2026-08-10-dr-*.sql reconstruction files there were 15 objects and 1 column in production that no file created: tables bug_reports / beta_invites / chat_blocks, function claim_beta_invite(text), function rls_auto_enable() + event trigger ensure_rls, sequence game_saves_id_seq, 6 policies, 3 indexes, 5 constraints, and profiles.updated_at. All are now reconstructed.
open: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations holds 27 rows; 12 have NO file in this repo (anon_lockdown_public_default_fix, profiles_identity_authority_and_global_default_acl, profiles_drop_dead_update_policy, grant_hygiene_v2_detector, hr_rate_sample_weight_pin_search_path, player_tables_rls_initplan, cron_health_no_false_stale_on_new_jobs, maintenance_fn_revoke_service_role, revoke_hr_engine_from_authenticator, disarm_broken_market_crons, clan_leaderboard_join_policy, clan_join_policy_merge_r4_tolerance). Their EFFECTS are all reproduced by the replay — the object diff above is clean — so no object is lost. Their SQL is still recoverable verbatim from that table's `statements` column if it is ever wanted. Nothing applied after 2026-08-11 is recorded there at all, because later files were applied with execute_sql rather than apply_migration.
NOT CHECKED HERE — grants and role memberships. hr_assert_grant_hygiene() owns that surface and is a stronger check than a fingerprint would be. Do not duplicate it.
how_to_remeasure: Run the replay inventory, then set-difference it against the live catalog:
relations   : select c.relkind::text||' '||c.relname::text from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','v','m','S')
functions   : select p.proname::text||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public'
policies    : select tablename||' :: '||policyname from pg_policies where schemaname='public'
indexes     : select indexname::text from pg_indexes where schemaname='public'

triggers    : select c.relname::text||' :: '||t.tgname::text from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and not t.tgisinternal

constraints : select c.relname::text||' :: '||co.conname::text from pg_constraint co join pg_class c on c.oid=co.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=co.connamespace where n.nspname='public' and co.contype <> 'n'

columns     : select c.relname::text||'.'||a.attname::text||' '||format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)||case when a.attnotnull then ' NOT NULL' else '' end||case when a.attgenerated<>'' then ' GENERATED' else '' end from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','v','m') and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped

rls         : select c.relname::text||' rls='||c.relrowsecurity::text||' force='||c.relforcerowsecurity::text from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind='r'
event_trigs : select et.evtname::text||' on '||et.evtevent::text from pg_event_trigger et where pg_get_userbyid(et.evtowner) not in ('supabase_admin')
NOTE: PGlite is PG18 and production is PG17. Exclude pg_constraint contype='n' (PG18
catalogues NOT NULL as a constraint row and PG17 does not): 484 vs 164 otherwise.
applied_2026_08_14: CLOSED — 2026-08-11-apply-engine.sql APPLIED. hr_apply body 25,966 -> 47,457 chars; intent_mismatch, gold_in and hr_day_budget_check now present; c_max_xp_delta 12,000,000. Proven behaviourally against the live body (intent collision, hostile replay, stale and future version all refused; a legitimate delta paid) in a rolled-back transaction.

CLOSED — 2026-08-12-raid-band-fairness.sql APPLIED, amended first. The three grant-to-authenticated statements became REVOKEs: they created client-callable RPCs with no hr_client_rpc_baseline rows, which is exactly what check (2) of hr_assert_grant_hygiene raises on, and that runs nightly on cron hr-grant-hygiene (50 4 * * *). Verified after: all three exist, authenticated and anon both false, the SECURITY DEFINER owner still reaches them, percentile_cont gone from raid_claim__ungated, hr_hunt_band live, unapproved_client_rpcs [].

CLOSED — 2026-08-10-save-integrity.sql APPLIED, amended twice. (1) a plausibility ceiling (5000) stops one forged totalLevel latching an account out of cloud save forever and poisoning leaderboard_ranked irreversibly; (2) a thin clamp (new_tl <= 40, the client own FRESH_FLOOR) closes a CONFIRMED false positive — decideRestore uploads a smaller local save over a bigger cloud one whenever local is newer, and the unclamped rule refused every such write permanently, with nothing in src/** handling 23514. Verified against the LIVE trigger: adopt band ACCEPTED, unchanged level ACCEPTED, thin clobber REFUSED, implausible REFUSED, honest save after two refusals ACCEPTED. 6 game_saves rows untouched, 0 residue.
